step1a.title: See how invoices work
step1a.body: Normally, you would click here to create a new invoice for your grocery receipt.
step1a.body2: For this guided demo, we’ll reuse an existing invoice instead of creating a new one.
step1a.hint: Click “Next step” below to choose one of the existing invoices.

step1b.title: Invoice details (demo only)
step1b.body: This is where you would normally enter the year, invoice number, date and store.
step1b.hint: In this guided tour, the Create button is disabled because we’ll use an existing invoice instead.

step1c.title: Open an existing invoice
step1c.body: For this demo, we’ll reuse this existing invoice instead of creating a new one.
step1c.hint: Click the “View” button to see its items and how the calculator will use them.
